turns.text: There's a fire starting in my heart
turns.zh: 我心中燃起一团火

turns.text: Reaching a fever pitch, it's bringing me out the dark
turns.zh: 烧到白热化，把我从黑暗中拉了出来

turns.text: Finally I can see you crystal clear
turns.zh: 终于，我把你看得一清二楚

turns.text: Go ahead and sell me out and I'll lay your ship bare
turns.zh: 你尽管出卖我，我会把你的底细全抖出来

turns.text: See how I'll leave with every piece of you
turns.zh: 看我怎么把你的一切都带走

turns.text: Don't underestimate the things that I will do
turns.zh: 别低估我会做出什么事

turns.text: The scars of your love remind me of us
turns.zh: 你留下的伤痕让我想起我们

turns.text: They keep me thinking that we almost had it all
turns.zh: 它们让我一直想着，我们差一点就拥有了一切

turns.text: The scars of your love they leave me breathless
turns.zh: 你留下的伤痕让我喘不过气

turns.text: I can't help feeling
turns.zh: 我忍不住觉得

turns.text: We could've had it all (you're gonna wish you)
turns.zh: 我们本可以拥有一切（你会希望）

turns.text: (Never had met me)
turns.zh: （从没遇见过我）

turns.text: Rolling in the deep (tears are gonna fall)
turns.zh: 在深渊里翻滚（眼泪要掉下来）

turns.text: (Rolling in the deep)
turns.zh: （在深渊里翻滚）

turns.text: You had my heart inside (you're gonna wish you)
turns.zh: 你把我的心攥在（你会希望）

turns.text: Of your hands (never had met me)
turns.zh: 你手里（从没遇见过我）

turns.text: And you played it (tears are gonna fall)
turns.zh: 你却玩弄它（眼泪要掉下来）

turns.text: To the beat (rolling in the deep)
turns.zh: 跟着节拍（在深渊里翻滚）

turns.text: Baby, I have no story to be told
turns.zh: 宝贝，我没什么故事可讲

turns.text: But I've heard one on you, now I'm gonna make your head burn
turns.zh: 但我听说过你的事，现在我要让你头疼

turns.text: Think of me in the depths of your despair
turns.zh: 在你绝望的深渊里想起我

turns.text: Make a home down there, as mine sure won't be shared
turns.zh: 在那儿安个家吧，因为我的家绝不会跟你分享
